items.text: Free design tools and tutorials online.
Free NPTEL and SWAYAM lessons in design basics.
Feedback from a teacher or a working designer.
Graphic design: one brand identity, one poster set, one social media series and one layout with text.
Fashion design: sketches, a tech pack, a finished garment and a mood board.
Interior design: a floor plan, a render, a materials board and a before-and-after if you have one.
For each piece, add the brief, your role and one line on what you would change.
